edges.reason: makeBet reads bets[msg.sender] to check whether an open bet already exists
makeBet writes value and height back into the bets mapping for msg.sender
msg.sender is used as the attacker-controlled key indexing bets in makeBet
resolveBet loads the stored Bet for msg.sender from the bets mapping
msg.sender selects which stored bet resolveBet reads and resolves
local newBet holds the values assigned by makeBet before they are persisted
values written into the local newBet copy are stored into the bets state mapping
local bet is a copy of the state entry bets[msg.sender] in resolveBet
dist is computed as block.number minus bet.height taken from the local bet copy
dist is range-checked by the require statement of resolveBet before hashing
the randomness operation derives hashVal from block.blockhash values that a miner can influence
hashVal is the dividend consumed by the division, cast and modulo computation
the narrowing uint16 cast and modulo of the division result truncate values into the payout-determining variable
the value of result (<= 495) branches into transferring the entire contract balance, making the payout depend on manipulable block data
resolveBet performs the balance transfer to the caller when the random result wins
msg.sender is the recipient address of the balance transfer operation
the external value transfer re-enters attacker-controlled code while resolveBet is still executing, though bet.height is reset before the call
